output.reason: The cited list item [ev-1fd7e824dbfd] only names the metric. Its parent section [ev-1f419676f177] states what changed. The subject is the metric `cortex_prometheus_rule_evaluation_duration_seconds_count`, one of the listed metrics that start with `cortex_`. In 3.0.0 its prefix changes from `cortex_` to `loki_`, because the default `metrics_namespace` is `loki`. Setting `metrics_namespace` to `cortex` keeps the old name, but that setting is deprecated and will be removed in the next minor release. This gives the applicability: deployments that keep the default `metrics_namespace` are exposed. It also gives the consequence: if the operator does nothing, the metric is emitted as `loki_prometheus_rule_evaluation_duration_seconds_count`, so anything that queries the `cortex_` name stops matching.
